runtime.reference_rationale: same version as ORT Web, so a comparison isolates the web runtime rather than a version delta

conversion_toolchain.pin_reason: paddlepaddle 3.3.1 + paddle2onnx 2.1.0 fails with 'DLL load failed while importing paddle2onnx_cpp2py_export'; 3.1.0 matches the extension ABI
conversion_toolchain.platform_note: no paddlepaddle wheel exists for the WSL2 guest's Python, so conversion runs on Windows

hosts.label: linux-wsl2
hosts.os: WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04 guest on the same Windows 11 host

threading.note: threading was not forced and no performance claim is made

model_loading.method: extension packaged resource read via runtime.getURL()
model_loading.why: 110.49 MB of weights cannot be base64-inlined; ~155 MB of JS string literal
model_loading.network: none - same-origin extension read, not egress

instrumentation.method: WebAssembly.Memory constructor AND Memory.prototype.grow wrapped before ORT loads
instrumentation.wasm_memory: measured directly, pages before and after each grow
instrumentation.js_heap: recorded SEPARATELY via performance.memory where available; never used as evidence about the WASM heap (S-04 showed it is GC-timing-dominated)
instrumentation.gpu_memory: NOT measured - no VRAM claim is made
